name: qa-my-app
description: Dev-only manifest for the QA My App plugin's test suite. The plugin itself ships no dependencies and is not an npm package.

scripts.check: for f in scripts/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.validate: npx -y @anthropic-ai/claude-code plugin validate . --strict && npx -y @anthropic-ai/claude-code plugin validate ./.claude-plugin/plugin.json --strict
